simple.meaning: תְּחִלָּה (tᵉchillâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a commencement ; relatively original (adverb, -ly).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 23 times across Genesis, Judges, Ruth, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 13:3. Its contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תְּחִלָּה (H8462).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: תְּחִלָּה (tᵉchillâh) / H8462 is traced through Genesis 13:3, Genesis 41:21, Genesis 43:18, Genesis 43:20 as a generated source-based concept entry.
